In the third step of the PUF-based device-model mating scheme, a physical or digital switch is thrown, blowing select fuses inside the inner (enclosed) hardware, which disallows another model installation thereafter. 

A physical unclonable function (PUF) is a mechanism that uses physical objects as private keys. If the object is changed even slightly, the private key is lost, making it a unique and secure method for authentication.
